summary: Amass Brands filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to update the resale registration for 14,293,298 shares of common stock from a direct listing on Nasdaq under symbol AMSS. The supplement discloses an amendment to a warrant held by Streeterville Capital, reducing the exercise price to $5.00 per share for a 90-day period (then reverting to $16.00). This is a routine shelf takedown and warrant modification, not a special situation.
